info.title: Sift Backend
info.description: Sift is an offline AI-powered code comprehension and debugging platform. Make sense of every line.

AnalysisBody.title: AnalysisBody
AnalysisBody.description: What the client asks for. ``file_id`` (or the transitional ``path``) picks the file; lines pick a selection.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: Deterministic reminder that AI output is advice, not proof.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: `explain`/`overview`: AI-generated overview in the requested depth's language. `debug`: DETERMINISTIC (built from `debug_outcome` and `coverage`); the AI's own debug summary is discarded because it contradicted its findings.

debug_outcome.title: Debug Outcome
debug_outcome.description: Deterministic, `debug` only. `no_clear_problem`: no finding reached the `possible_problem` tier and no rule found a problem in the code examined. This is NOT proof that the code is bug-free. `possible_problems`: at least one `possible_problem` finding or one `problem_if_assumptions_hold` pattern check exists.

pattern_checks.title: Pattern Checks
pattern_checks.description: Deterministic, `debug` only: hits from a few hand-written rules, each with its assumptions. Not AI output.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: Deterministic, `explain`/`overview` only: dependency edges around the selected file, from the project's parsers.

analogy.title: Analogy
analogy.description: AI-generated, `beginner` explain/overview only: an everyday comparison. Optional and imperfect.

explanations.title: Explanations
explanations.description: AI-generated, in order (step by step). Empty for `debug`.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: AI-generated suspicions with validated locations. Only for `debug`.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: AI-generated: things the AI says it could not confirm.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Deterministic, `beginner` depth only: plain-language meanings of common programming words found in the AI's text. Written by Sift, not by the AI, and bounded to a few entries.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Deterministic: what this analysis could not see or check.

timings_ms.title: Timings Ms
timings_ms.description: Deterministic: project, context, inference, validation, total.

BridgeAnalysisResponse.title: BridgeAnalysisResponse
BridgeAnalysisResponse.description: The engine's response, unchanged, plus the session identifiers and the selection disclosure.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: AI-generated: what the concept means, using this code as the example.

full_files.title: Full Files
full_files.description: Files whose whole content the AI was shown.

outline_only_files.title: Outline Only Files
outline_only_files.description: Files the AI saw only as signatures.

not_included_files.title: Not Included Files
not_included_files.description: Files the AI did not see (list is bounded; see the total).

excluded_files.title: Excluded Files
excluded_files.description: Archive files that were not analysed (list is bounded).

CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut
CoverageOut.description: Deterministic. Built from the real project and the real prompt; the AI contributes nothing here.

source_excerpt.title: Source Excerpt
source_excerpt.description: Deterministic: lines copied by the BACKEND from the uploaded file (never the AI's own quote), at most 15 lines starting at `excerpt_start_line`.

excerpt_matched.title: Excerpt Matched
excerpt_matched.description: Deterministic: whether the code the AI quoted really appears in the cited lines.

title.title: Title
title.description: AI-generated: short heading of this step or part.

description.title: Description
description.description: AI-generated explanation of this step or part.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Validated against the project; null if the AI gave none or an invalid one.

start_line.title: Start Line
start_line.description: First line, validated against what the AI was shown; null otherwise.

end_line.title: End Line
end_line.description: Last line, validated against what the AI was shown; null otherwise.

location_status.title: Location Status
location_status.description: Deterministic. `in_context`: the lines exist and were shown to the AI. `outline_only`: the range matches a symbol the AI saw only as a signature outline. `file_only`: a real file the AI was shown, no lines. `none`: no location was given. `rejected`: a location was given but is invalid (fields are null).

location_issue.title: Location Issue
location_issue.description: Deterministic. Why a location was rejected.

id.title: Id
id.description: Deterministic: F1, F2, ... assigned after validation and triage, in display order.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: AI-generated: what may be wrong, in the requested depth's language. A suspicion, not a proven bug.

what_could_happen.title: What Could Happen
what_could_happen.description: AI-generated: the effect if the problem is real.

suggestion.title: Suggestion
suggestion.description: AI-generated: a direction for fixing it.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: AI-generated qualitative rating of impact if the problem is real.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: AI-generated qualitative rating, NOT a probability. Forced to `low` for `unsupported` findings.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Deterministic. `source_verified`: the cited file and lines exist, were shown to the AI and the quoted code matches - this does NOT prove the bug is real. `hypothesis`: the location is valid but the quote is missing or does not match. `unsupported`: the location is invalid; it is removed.

evidence_issue.title: Evidence Issue
evidence_issue.description: Deterministic. Why the finding is not `source_verified`.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Deterministic presentation heuristic, NOT a correctness guarantee. `possible_problem`: shown first; the cited code was verified and nothing marked it as demo code or as a claim about unseen input, or an independent rule corroborated it. `worth_checking`: a note, shown after the possible problems; it is demoted, never hidden, and may still be a real bug (for example a genuine missing input check).

tier_reasons.title: Tier Reasons
tier_reasons.description: Deterministic. Why the tier was chosen. Demoting reasons: QUOTE_NOT_MATCHED, LOCATION_NOT_VERIFIED, IN_DEMO_CODE, INPUT_ASSUMPTION. Promoting: CORROBORATED_BY_RULE. May be listed even when the finding stayed a possible problem (corroboration overrides the demoting reasons).

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Model calls made for this request (the first try, retries and the compact fallback).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `compact` means the first answer was cut off at the output limit, so a shorter one was requested.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: Deterministic: stable rule identifier, e.g. PY_INDEX_PAST_END.

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: Deterministic. `problem_if_assumptions_hold`: this is a mistake PROVIDED every assumption listed below is true. `worth_checking`: suspicious, but it depends on what the author intended.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Deterministic, written for the requested depth.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: Deterministic: what must be true for this to be a real problem. Always shown with the hit.

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: `confirmed`: found with Python's own parser. `heuristic`: found with Sift's lightweight JavaScript scanner.

source_excerpt.title: Source Excerpt
source_excerpt.description: Deterministic: lines copied by the backend from the uploaded file (at most 15).

shown_to_ai.title: Shown To Ai
shown_to_ai.description: Deterministic: whether these lines were part of what the AI was shown.

corroborates.title: Corroborates
corroborates.description: Deterministic: ids of AI findings on the same lines.

PatternCheckOut.title: PatternCheckOut
PatternCheckOut.description: A deterministic rule hit (``bug_patterns.py``). Not AI-generated, and not proof of a bug.

to.title: To
to.description: The project file it refers to, or the unresolved reference as written.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `uses`: imports or requires. `loads`: a script, stylesheet or asset reference. `entry_point`: marks `from` as a heuristic entry point (`to` equals `from`). A file's users are the edges whose `to` is that file.

resolved.title: Resolved
resolved.description: False when the reference does not match a file in the upload.

RelationshipOut.title: RelationshipOut
RelationshipOut.description: A dependency-graph edge (mirrors the frontend's ``Relationship``). Deterministic, from the parsers: never the AI.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: `project`: whole-project overview. `file`: one whole file. `symbol`: one function, method or class.

requested.description: The learner's selection, exactly as sent. Null when no lines were selected.

analyzed_symbol.title: Analyzed Symbol
analyzed_symbol.description: Qualified name of the function/class that was analysed, if any.

analyzed_lines.description: Lines the analysis was centred on: the symbol, or the whole file. Null for a project overview.

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain-language disclosure shown whenever `expanded` is true.

SelectionInfo.title: SelectionInfo
SelectionInfo.description: What was asked for versus what was analysed. Deterministic: computed by the backend, never by the AI.
